select
  $1::text as device_id,
  $2::text as track_id,
  coalesce(
    (
      select track_uuid
      from public.sync_tracks
      where device_id = $1
        and track_id = $2
      order by updated_at desc
      limit 1
    ),
    null
  ) as track_uuid,
  coalesce(
    (
      select track_hash
      from public.sync_tracks
      where device_id = $1
        and track_id = $2
      order by updated_at desc
      limit 1
    ),
    $4::text
  ) as track_hash,
  $3::bigint as rb_local_usn,
  coalesce(
    (
      select updated_at
      from public.sync_tracks
      where device_id = $1
        and track_id = $2
      order by updated_at desc
      limit 1
    ),
    now()
  ) as updated_at,
  (
    select track
    from public.sync_tracks
    where device_id = $1
      and track_id = $2
    order by updated_at desc
    limit 1
  ) as track,
  exists (
    select 1
    from public.sync_tracks
    where device_id = $1
      and track_id = $2
  ) as track_found;

with existing as (
  select
    event_id,
    status,
    attempts,
    updated_at
  from public.n8n_event_receipts
  where event_id = $1::uuid
  for update
),
claimed as (
  insert into public.n8n_event_receipts (
    event_id,
    event_type,
    device_id,
    status,
    attempts,
    received_at,
    updated_at,
    last_error
  )
  select
    $1::uuid,
    $2,
    $3,
    'processing',
    1,
    now(),
    now(),
    null
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from existing
  )
  returning
    event_id,
    1 as attempts
),
reclaimed as (
  update public.n8n_event_receipts r
  set
    status = 'processing',
    attempts = r.attempts + 1,
    updated_at = now(),
    last_error = null,
    processed_at = null
  where r.event_id = $1::uuid
    and r.status in ('processing', 'failed')
    and r.updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
  returning
    r.event_id,
    r.attempts
),
candidate as (
  select
    event_id,
    attempts
  from claimed

  union all

  select
    event_id,
    attempts
  from reclaimed
),
decision as (
  select
    c.event_id,
    c.attempts,
    case
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.sync_changes sc
        where sc.device_id = $3
          and sc.track_id = $4
          and sc.rb_local_usn > $5::bigint
      )
        then 'superseded'

      when c.attempts = 1
        then 'process'

      else
        'retry'
    end as action
  from candidate c
)
select action
from decision

union all

select 'duplicate'::text
where not exists (
  select 1
  from candidate
);

update public.n8n_event_receipts
set
  status = 'processed',
  processed_at = now(),
  updated_at = now(),
  last_error = null
where event_id = $1::uuid
  and status = 'processing'
returning
  event_id,
  status,
  attempts,
  processed_at;

  device_id,

  key,
  remixer,
  bpm,

  length_seconds,

  sample_rate,
  play_count,
  processed_at
)
values (

  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  nullif($7, 'null')::bigint,
  nullif($8, 'null'),

    limit 1
  ) as previous_event_id,
  (
    select title
    from public.n8n_track_event_audit
    where device_id = $1
      and track_id = $2
      and event_id <> $3::uuid

    from public.n8n_track_event_audit
    where device_id = $1
      and track_id = $2
      and event_id <> $3::uuid
    order by created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) as previous_play_count,
  (
    select rb_local_usn
    from public.n8n_track_event_audit
    where device_id = $1
      and track_id = $2
      and event_id <> $3::uuid
    order by created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) as previous_rb_local_usn,
  (
    select track_hash
    from public.n8n_track_event_audit
    where device_id = $1
      and track_id = $2
      and event_id <> $3::uuid
    order by created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) as previous_track_hash;

with inserted as (
  insert into public.n8n_track_change_log (
    event_id,
    device_id,
    track_id,
    event_type,
    field_name,
    previous_value,
    current_value,
    rb_local_usn
  )
  select
    $1::uuid,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    change.field_name,
    nullif(change.previous_value, 'null'),
    nullif(change.current_value, 'null'),
    nullif($5, 'null')::bigint
  from jsonb_to_recordset($6::jsonb) as change(
    field_name text,
    previous_value text,
    current_value text
  )
  on conflict (event_id, field_name) do nothing
  returning
    id
)
select
  count(*)::integer as inserted_changes;

where event_id = $1::uuid

returning

  status,
  attempts,
  processed_at,

set

  processed_at = null,

parameters.jsCode:
const src = $('Normalize Track Deleted').item.json;
const job = {
  job_key: `${src.deviceId}:${src.trackId}:track.intelligence.retire:${src.rbLocalUsn}`,
  job_type: 'track.intelligence.retire',
  priority: 70,
  event_id: src.eventId,
  device_id: src.deviceId,
  track_id: src.trackId,
  rb_local_usn: src.rbLocalUsn,
  payload: {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    eventId: src.eventId,
    eventType: src.eventType,
    deviceId: src.deviceId,
    trackId: src.trackId,
    trackUuid: src.trackUuid,
    trackHash: src.trackHash,
    rbLocalUsn: src.rbLocalUsn,
    title: src.title ?? null,
    artist: src.artist ?? null,
    album: src.album ?? null,
    genre: src.genre ?? null,
    key: src.key ?? null,
    remixer: src.remixer ?? null,
    bpm: src.bpm ?? null,
    rating: src.rating ?? null,
    lengthSeconds: src.lengthSeconds ?? null,
    bitrate: src.bitrate ?? null,
    sampleRate: src.sampleRate ?? null,
    playCount: src.playCount ?? null,
    reason: 'track_deleted',
  },
};
return [{ json: { ...src, intelligenceJobs: [job], intelligenceJobCount: 1 } }];
